name: Agentic workflow and MCP boundary review
signals: agent has tools or data broader than its stated task
untrusted content reaches a privileged tool
inter-agent messages are trusted without provenance
MCP server source or permissions are unclear
workflow can send data to an unapproved destination
safe_tests: map the workflow, tools, data stores, and outbound destinations first
inspect manifests, prompts, and MCP definitions statically
use synthetic markers and self-owned test data
test one instruction or tool boundary at a time
do not trigger payments, messaging, deletion, external side effects, or real credential use
confirm: the workflow crosses a real trust or permission boundary
a synthetic marker proves unauthorized tool or data access
the result is attributable to the agent design rather than the test harness
human review confirms the impact and safe reproduction
false_positives: model refusal without a boundary bypass
prompt text that never reaches a privileged decision
test-only secret that has no production authority
